text.feels_intro: How {name}'s electrical burns feel right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: a faint red, branching mark, with singed hair standing on end. A sharp smell of ozone and singed hair clings to {him}.
{name}'s face: red, branching burn marks across the cheek and temple, the skin blistered. {name} smells of ozone and scorched skin.
{name}'s face: deep, black-edged burn marks branching across {his} face, the skin split and smoking. The acrid stench of burnt hair and flesh hangs about {him}.
body: {name}'s back: a faint red, branching mark through the clothing. A faint whiff of ozone hangs about {him}.
{name}'s back: red, branching burn marks, blistered and scorched through the clothing. {name} smells of ozone and scorched cloth.
{name}'s back: deep, black-edged burn marks branching across {his} back; the clothing smolders. {name} reeks of burnt cloth and seared flesh.
arm: {name}'s {part}: a faint red, branching mark; the hand twitches. It carries a faint, sharp smell of ozone.
{name}'s {part}: red, branching burn marks, blistered; the fingers curl and tremble. It smells of ozone and scorched skin.
{name}'s {part}: deep, black-edged burn marks; the arm trembles and the hand is clenched like a claw. It gives off an acrid smell of burnt flesh.
leg: {name}'s {part}: a faint red, branching mark; the muscle twitches. A faint smell of ozone clings to {him}.
{name}'s {part}: red, branching burn marks, blistered; the muscle trembles. It smells sharply of ozone and singed skin.
{name}'s {part}: deep, black-edged burn marks; the leg trembles and spasms. An acrid stench of seared flesh rises from it.

head: {name}'s face tingles and buzzes and {his} ears ring. {name} is jumpy and blinks hard.
{name}'s face burns and twitches, {his} teeth aching from the current. {name} is shaken and stammering.
{name}'s face is white-hot agony and numb in patches, {his} vision flashing. {name} is dazed and barely coherent.
body: {name}'s back tingles and buzzes, the muscles twitching. {name} is jumpy and tense.
{name}'s back burns and clenches in spasms. {name} is stiff and shaky and breathes in jerks.
{name}'s back is white-hot agony and the muscles will not stop convulsing. {name} is dazed and close to collapse.
arm: {name}'s {part} tingles and buzzes, the fingers twitching. {name} shakes it out.
{name}'s {part} burns and spasms, the grip failing. {name} cradles it, trembling.
{name}'s {part} is white-hot agony and numb in patches; the hand will not open. {name} is shocked and speechless.
leg: {name}'s {part} tingles and buzzes, the muscle twitching. {name} shakes it out as {he} walks.
{name}'s {part} burns and spasms with every step. {name} stumbles and limps.
{name}'s {part} is white-hot agony and will not hold weight, jerking in spasms. {name} collapses or needs support.

levels: , a sudden crack of current. The jolt throws {his} muscles into a spasm, and {he} jerks with a yelp. The air smells sharply of ozone.
through muscles that are already jangling. The current arcs through the burn, and {he} convulses as the pain flares. The smell of ozone and singed hair rises.
, and the lightning arcs through the burns. The pain is blinding and {he} locks up in a spasm, hair standing on end and breath gone. The acrid stench of burnt flesh fills the air.
, and it is too much. The current floods {him}; {he} convulses, smoking, then goes slack, {his} heart stuttering.

start.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}, beginning to heal {own} wounds and pain.
start.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light, beginning to heal {own} wounds and pain.

start_unhurt.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}. With no wounds to mend, it simply washes over {obj}, warm and soothing.
start_unhurt.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. With no wounds to mend, it simply feels warm and soothing.

pain_gone.none: The pain from {name}'s injuries is gone, but the healing continues.
pain_gone.source: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} has taken the pain from {own} injuries, but the healing continues.

full.none: {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {him} without pain or blemish.
full.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}. {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {him} without pain or blemish.
full.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {him} without pain or blemish.

heal_events.stopped: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} fades before the healing is done; {own} injuries are {progress}.

head: the lightning bursts {his} eyes in their sockets; blood runs from the hollows, from {his} ears and nose, and {his} hair smokes and curls. The sharp smell of ozone, burned hair and blood fills the air as {name} jerks, stiffens and falls dead.

the bolt strikes {his} head and {his} jaw clamps shut so hard the teeth crack; branching burns spread over {his} blackened face and blood trickles from {his} ears. {name} convulses and drops, smoke rising from {him} in the stink of scorched skin and ozone.
body: the lightning seizes {his} heart; fern-like burns branch black across {his} back and chest, the skin split and smoking where it entered. {name} goes rigid, shaking violently, then collapses, a last choked cry cut short, in the smell of ozone and cooked flesh.

the bolt tears through {his} back and out {his} chest, leaving a blackened, smoking hole ringed with burst blisters; the heart stops mid-beat. {name} falls jerking, blood frothing from {his} mouth, and the air reeks of ozone, burned cloth and scorched meat.
arm: the lightning chars {his} {part} black from fingertips to shoulder; the fingers are curled into stiff claws and the skin has burst open along the bone. {name} convulses as the current stops {his} heart, and falls with a strangled scream into the stink of burned flesh and ozone.

the bolt splits {his} {part} open along its length; smoking, cooked muscle shows through the char and the hand is a blackened, twisted claw. {name} shakes and jerks on the ground, then lies still, the smell of scorched meat and hot metal thick around {him}.
leg: the lightning runs down {his} {part} and bursts out through the foot; the leg is blackened and split, the boot burned through, the muscles knotted rigid. {name} falls jerking, kicking helplessly until {his} heart stops, and smoke rises from {him} in the stink of ozone and burned hair.

the bolt chars {his} {part} to the bone in branching black lines; the flesh splits and smokes, and the leg twitches long after {name} falls. {name}'s scream breaks off into a choked gasp and then silence, the air sharp with ozone and scorched flesh.

soil: The current wrenches {his} bowels and bladder open, and the stink of shit and piss mixes with the smell of ozone and burned flesh.
As {his} body goes slack, the stench of {his} shit and piss joins the smell of scorched skin.
